_comment: Pins for perf runs (design §5.4, §8.6). The anchor and the external reference are side installs (pip --target) under build/perf/builds/. Changing anything here changes the lock hash every run record carries; a change of python minor version starts a new epoch. riscv-dv is checked out at its pinned commit under build/perf/builds/riscv-dv-<sha>.
